0022600156.text: The Clippers (1-4, 0-3 on the road, losers of four straight) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, winners of three straight) in the sixth game of their season, sitting 14th in the West and 2.5 games back for fourth in the Pacific, while Golden State is 10th in the West and one game back for second in the Pacific. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Warriors are without Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), with Gui Santos listed as day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
